svg.title: Registering and replacing session hosts
svg.desc: Registering: the host pool issues a registration token that is entered when the agent is installed. On the session host, the Remote Desktop Agent Boot Loader loads the agent and opens an outbound TLS channel to the Azure Virtual Desktop service. The Infrastructure Agent takes the token, and the side-by-side network stack and Geneva Monitoring Agent are health checked. Replacing: with a session host configuration, edit it, schedule an update, update one host first and then the rest in batches. For each host: notify users, turn on drain mode, create new hosts, join the host pool, then delete or deallocate the original VMs.
